scope: Keep chat drafts readable as the desktop window changes size, and keep oversized-message validation accessible and recoverable in both themes.
qualification: Local Linux acceptance. Native networking uses an owned local workflow fixture, not real sandbox/Temporal/NSR execution.

failures: Draft height did not refit when the available width changed, in both native themes.
The oversized-message warning failed the light-theme WCAG contrast check.
The unit regression confirmed that changing the draft width did not update its height.
observed_regressions.baseline_source: A copied set of 618 tracked inputs with new regression tests and the original composer. Queued scripts were atomically updated to use it and confirmed still queued before implementation changed.

implementation: Observe textarea width changes and refit its draft height. Keep the existing 160-pixel cap so long drafts remain scrollable.
Coalesce width changes into an animation frame outside observer delivery. Ignore height-only notifications and cancel pending frames and observers on unmount.
Use the existing theme-aware error color for message-limit warnings.
Preserve existing controlled draft ownership, persisted oversized text, UTF-8 byte validation, input-method and Enter behavior.

native_setup_correction.reason: Lint rejected a test helper inside the theme loop (no-inner-declarations); moved it to program root and passed theme explicitly. Composer source unchanged.

verification.preflight: Root and E2E types, lint, Electron and renderer builds passed. Full coverage and all configured thresholds passed.
verification.native_composer_cases: Dark/light: real window narrowing and widening without editing, focus/text retention, long-draft scrolling and shrinking, no message signal during editing; 8,004-byte drafts remain saved and editable, block Enter, pass WCAG scans, and enable Send after shortening to exactly 8,000 bytes.

source_guard.method: Manual SHA256 of tracked inputs before and after verification; not an immutable Buildr snapshot.

limitations: Owned local workflow fixture; no real sandbox/Temporal/NSR acceptance.
No signed release publication; v1.1.19 unchanged.
Three opt-in live checks require staging configuration.
Existing dependency findings remain documented in desktop-security-2026-10-15.json; no dependency or version changes in this patch.
